author: reconcile-hygiene unit (todo_ab3b61bf54f4)
purpose: One entry per invocation that should be measured, so the STALE half has a recorded expectation instead of a number a reviewer has to interpret. `authoritative` is the report + section the DOC ITSELF declares current: that is the pairing an acceptance check should use, and it must have 0 COVERED rows or a recorded justification. The `superseded-*`/`wide` roles exist to make the wide invocation's non-zero COVERED count explainable rather than alarming: each carries the quote that says it is history.

role_help.authoritative: the report + section the doc declares current; COVERED must be 0 or justified
role_help.superseded-ledger: a ledger the doc itself marks superseded, kept in the same file
role_help.wide: no --section: every ledger in the doc at once (the number a careless invocation prints)
role_help.superseded-report: a report the doc's own newer measurement replaces
